name: read_page
description: Read the full markdown body of a single wiki document. Use this AFTER `search_wiki` identifies a relevant page — snippets from search are not enough to answer detailed questions or to plan an edit. Returns `{path, title, body}`. Errors if the path doesn't exist or isn't a `.md` file. Calling `read_page` on a path is the only way to satisfy the read-before-write requirement enforced by `edit_doc` / `multi_edit` / `write_doc` for existing files.

path.description: Wiki-relative path to the markdown file (e.g. `auth/passwords.md`). Must end in `.md`.
